sections.label: Geylang East Library relocation concerns
sections.summary: NLB plans to relocate Geylang East Library to Tanjong Katong Complex in 2030, and residents voiced concerns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Already, the National Library Board (NLB) has put in tremendous effort to go digital over the years, preserving precious data and publications using digital means, introducing apps and more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: That being said, it is with a heavy heart that we learn of the Geylang East Library ceasing operations at its current premise in 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: The plan, as announced by NLB is to relocate the library to the new Tanjong Katong Complex.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Residents from MacPherson, and nearby constituencies, such as Jalan Besar and Geylang Serai, had voiced concerns about this decision.

sections.label: NLB relocation reasons and costs
sections.summary: NLB cites lower visitorship and loans, mall synergy, and higher in-situ revamp costs as reasons for relocating the library.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Having learnt of the relocation, I reached out to NLB to appeal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: According to NLB, both its visitorship and loans are consistently lower when compared to other public libraries over the last few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Therefore, moving it to the revamped Tanjong Katong Complex will enable NLB, which is publicly funded and with a public mission, to reach out to a larger catchment, while still being able to serve the residents in MacPherson.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: This is because of the synergy with other activities in a shopping mall.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Therefore, under the Library of the Future Masterplan, NLB's strategy is to move standalone libraries to shopping malls when opportunities come about.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Thirdly, NLB considered the alternative approach of retaining the library at its current location and revamping it in-situ.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: But it is not cost effective to do so given the ageing infrastructure and it will cost much more than co-locating it in a shopping mall.

sections.label: Adult physical book reading decline
sections.summary: Physical book reading among adults dropped to 75% in 2024 from 89% in 2018, while e-book reading held steady.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: While e-book reading has held steady, physical book reading among adults dropped to 75% in 2024, compared to 89% in 2018.

sections.label: Library visitorship and loans 2024
sections.summary: In 2024 libraries had 20.8 million visitors, 24 million physical items checked out, and 14.8 million digital items borrowed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Library visitorship and physical loans in 2024 have remained strong, with 20.8 million visitors to our network of libraries, the National Library and the National Archives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Our patrons have also checked out 24 million physical items in 2024, showing that Singaporeans continue to value the physical library experience.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: At the same time, digital consumption of information continues to be on the rise, with library members borrowing 14.8 million digital items in 2024.

sections.label: Libraries of the Future Masterplan
sections.summary: A 15-year masterplan from 2017 to 2030 systematically revamps and upgrades older public libraries in community hubs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Our libraries must remain accessible and be conveniently located in key community hubs where Singaporeans live, work and play.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: This has guided the formulation of the Libraries of the Future Masterplan, a 15-year masterplan to systematically revamp and upgrade the older public libraries from 2017 to 2030.

sections.label: Geylang East visitorship drop and costs
sections.summary: Geylang East Library visitorship fell about 31% from 2015 to 2024, and in-situ revamp would cost $22 million more.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: In the last decade, from 2015 to 2024, Geylang East Library has experienced declining visitorship from 670,000 to less than 470,000, about a 31% drop.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: We hope the relocation will help to improve the visitorship for the library, just as it did for the libraries at Harbourfront and Tampines, which saw a 58% and 71% increase in visitorship respectively over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: However, it will cost more than two times per square metre to revamp it in its current location as compared to relocating it to Tanjong Katong Complex.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: This translates into a budgetary difference of $22 million.
